limits: The browser positive control simulates a temporary field/row height mismatch; it does not reproduce the complete native event sequence.

The native check temporarily selects an existing paper when required and uses a 640px metadata pane. It restores the selection, collection, tab, open section, and original pane/table styles after measurement. It does not edit the citation key.

The native height check did not pass: the background input remained 9.13px wide. This result does not verify the visible field height. Both official desktop-control interfaces reported an unavailable native pipe.
The native checks use the built-in self-check. No manual desktop click test ran.
No live AI, backfill, or repair request was made by the added checks.
